{{Quote|The crystal and the ivory tooth. These are for other Ewoks who must be found and persuaded to join the caravan.|The Narrator|<ref name="Caravan" />}}
The '''Ivory Tooth''' was a sacred [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] item that once belonged to an ancient Ewok warrior. It was a small white tooth from an unknown animal. Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], prior to the journey to locate and rescue the parents of the shipwrecked [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Mace Towani|Mace]] and [[Cindel Towani]] from a [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], the tooth was given to the Ewok [[Deej Warrick]], in hopes that along the journey, the caravan would find two new Ewoks to join them on their journey by the village shaman, [[Logray/Legends|Logray]]. The first Ewok they found was [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]], who gladly accepted the tooth from Deej after almost dropping a tree on the group. Mace disagreed with this choice, challenging Chukha-Trok to an [[Axe/Legends|axe]] throwing competition. Mace lost, amazing him, and convincing him to give the tooth to Chukha-Trok himself, begging him to join the caravan. Once again, Chukha-Trok accepted, taking the tooth and joining the group, adding the tooth to an animal skull worn around his neck.<ref name="Caravan" />

Chukha-Trok carried the tooth with him until his death at the hands of the Gorax.<ref name="Caravan" />
